```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                       fig.align = "center", fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4)

if (!exists("project_folder")) {
  project_folder <- getwd()
  pipeline_folder <- getwd()
  features_file <- "config/features.yaml"
  sample_file <- "config/samples.tsv"
}

source(file.path(pipeline_folder, "workflow", "scripts", "R", "report_helpers.R"))
samples <- read.delim(file.path(project_folder, sample_file), comment.char = "#")
assembly_ids <- unique(unlist(strsplit(samples$assembly_ids, ",\\s*")))
assemble_dir <- file.path(project_folder, "results", "assemble")

count_bins <- function(dir) {
  if (!dir.exists(dir)) return(NA_integer_)
  length(Sys.glob(file.path(dir, "*.fa.gz")))
}
```

# Assembly and binning summary

One row per assembly: number of bins produced by each binner, and the number
of refined bins MAGScoT kept after combining them.

```{r binning-summary}
binning_df <- purrr::map_dfr(assembly_ids, function(a) {
  magscot_refined <- file.path(assemble_dir, "magscot", a, "magscot.refined.contig_to_bin.out")
  n_refined <- if (file.exists(magscot_refined) && file.size(magscot_refined) > 0) {
    length(unique(read.delim(magscot_refined, header = FALSE)[[1]]))
  } else {
    0L
  }
  tibble::tibble(
    assembly_id = a,
    concoct_bins = count_bins(file.path(assemble_dir, "concoct", a)),
    maxbin2_bins = count_bins(file.path(assemble_dir, "maxbin2", a)),
    metabat2_bins = count_bins(file.path(assemble_dir, "metabat2", a)),
    magscot_refined_bins = n_refined
  )
})
preview_table(binning_df, n = nrow(binning_df), caption = "Bins per assembly, by binner")
```

# Dereplication (dRep)

```{r drep-summary, results='asis'}
sep_dir <- file.path(assemble_dir, "drep", "separated_bins")
derep_dir <- file.path(assemble_dir, "drep", "dereplicated_genomes")
n_before <- if (dir.exists(sep_dir)) length(Sys.glob(file.path(sep_dir, "*.fa"))) else NA
n_after <- if (dir.exists(derep_dir)) length(Sys.glob(file.path(derep_dir, "*"))) else NA

cat(sprintf(
  "**%s** bins went into dRep across all assemblies; **%s** representative genomes remained after dereplication.\n\n",
  ifelse(is.na(n_before), "?", n_before), ifelse(is.na(n_after), "?", n_after)
))
```
